svg.title: RISC-V specification database: a split-flap board spelling out add, lw and addi as 32-bit instruction words, flap by flap, with the fields of each bracketed beneath and the board reflected in the desk. A pipeline that loads 1,700+ YAML specification files into PostgreSQL.
